t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Me ne nga a Zambe wom, na Ônga té ma na yeme Wo a kań fe Wo. Ma mem éyoń ji na, Ngul jam éno momo ve enjoé nje éné, na me ne azoé ve Wo Ône Kum; Zambe mfe anji bo ve Wo étam, Nyô a volô éyon ya njuk, Nyô a vee be emien.
